metadata.purpose: Structure for LLM to extract D&D module data into AI-executable format
metadata.outputFormat: System prompt for AI Dungeon Master

npc.name: Runara
npc.description: Runs Dragon's Rest cloister disguised as an elderly human woman. Is an adult bronze dragon with commitment to peace and reconciliation.

personality.motivation: Promote peace and stop violence between chromatic and metallic dragons

npc.name: Tarak
npc.description: Human gardener of Dragon's Rest, former poisoner from a thieves' guild with a dark past.

personality.motivation: Atonement for his past and peaceful life

npc.name: Varnoth
npc.description: Human female, retired mercenary general at Dragon's Rest, gruff yet observant and empathetic.

npc.name: Myla
npc.description: Winged kobold tinkerer at Dragon's Rest recovering from wing injury with help from Runara.

personality.motivation: Invent and create to help the cloister

npc.name: Agga
npc.description: Organizational kobold with little patience for nonsense, leads other kobolds at Dragon’s Rest.

personality.motivation: Maintain order and respect within the cloister

npc.name: Blepp
npc.description: Kobold with sharp danger-sense and belief that his dagger is magical.

npc.name: Frub
npc.description: Energetic kobold who desperately seeks focus.

npc.name: Laylee
npc.description: Curious kobold, talented with tools, Myla's assistant.

npc.name: Mumpo
npc.description: Audacious kobold who stole a copper piece from Runara's hoard.

personality.motivation: Deceive and prank the cloister leader

npc.name: Rix
npc.description: Pious kobold, guardian of the temple, assistant to Runara.

personality.motivation: Preserve temple rituals and support Runara

npc.name: Zark
npc.description: Rude kobold with fondness for colorful insults, indifferent to visitors.

npc.name: Sparkrender
npc.description: Blue dragon wyrmling occupying Clifftop Observatory, aggressive and arrogant.

personality.motivation: Claim power of dead dragons and dominate the island

behaviorScripts.onCombatStart: Use Breath Weapon first turn; taunt players with dialogue

npc.name: Aidron
npc.description: Bronze dragon wyrmling imprisoned in Clifftop Observatory, opposed to Sparkrender.

location.name: Dragon's Rest Cloister
location.description: A small cloister perched on a cliff overlooking the north harbor of Stormwreck Isle. It includes monastic cells, temple of Bahamut, kitchen, library, and winch house.

features.name: Temple of Bahamut
features.description: Open-air temple with statue of Bahamut surrounded by incense offerings that grants +d4 bonus to saving throws to non-evil creatures while inside.

features.name: Library Door
features.description: Oak and iron banded door leading to quiet library, containing theological and historical scrolls and books.

location.name: Seagrow Caves
location.description: Caves inhabited by myconids near the southwest of the island, infected by blight from the red dragon's tomb. Features fungi, a spore servant octopus, and fume drakes guarding an orange crystal.

features.name: Blocked Orange Crystal
features.description: A large orange crystal blocking the fissure that vents noxious fumes from the dragon’s tomb, source of blight.

interaction.onSuccess: Crystal shatters, fumes vented, blight ends

location.name: Compass Rose Shipwreck
location.description: Ruined shipwreck north of the island where drowned sailors become zombies. Harpy roosts here luring ships to the rocks. Contains cursed talisman causing zombie curse.

features.name: Captain's Chest
features.description: Heavy iron chest in the hold containing captain's journal, turquoise stones, and boots of elvenkind.

secrets.description: Captain's journal revealing cursed talisman and undead curse on shipwreck victims

location.name: Clifftop Observatory
location.description: Ruined ancient magical observatory on basalt spires. Blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender holds the site with his kobold followers. Contains trapped bronze wyrmling Aidron.

features.name: Energy Bridges
features.description: Magical bridges that connect basalt columns, activated by moonstone key

features.name: Hidden Library Entrance
features.description: Secret spiral staircase triggered by rotating four scholar statues correctly

item.name: Mumpo's Copper Piece
item.description: Copper coin Mumpo stole from Runara's hoard

item.name: Incense Offering
item.description: Offering incense for Bahamut at the Dragon's Rest temple

item.name: Blepp's Dagger
item.description: An ordinary dagger that Blepp believes is magical

item.name: Ruby Morel
item.description: A glowing red fungus treasured by myconids, used by Tarak to make an elixir of health.

effects.onUse: Removes blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions.

item.name: Aleitha's Talisman
item.description: A cursed talisman made from braided lock of hair and finger bones, cause of undead curse.

effects.onUse: Breaking or burying at Brastos' grave ends zombie curse.

item.name: Moonstone Key
item.description: Hexagonal prism of moonstone with a dragon head engraving. Used to activate energy bridges at Clifftop Observatory.

item.name: Energy Bridge Activator
item.description: Special item or component required to operate energy bridges at the Observatory.

faction.name: Dragon's Rest Cloister
faction.goal: Maintain peace and reconciliation on Stormwreck Isle

faction.name: Sparkrender's Kobolds
faction.goal: Help Sparkrender seize power over Stormwreck Isle

primaryGoal.description: Prevent Sparkrender from completing his ritual and neutralize the threats on Stormwreck Isle.

questGraph.name: Defeat Zombies at Beach
questGraph.description: Fight or avoid the zombies at Dragon's Rest beach to protect the cloister.

objectives.description: Defeat all three zombies at the beach or successfully avoid them

questGraph.name: Investigate Compass Rose Shipwreck
questGraph.description: Explore the wreck of Compass Rose to discover the source of the zombie plague.

objectives.description: Retrieve the cursed talisman and captain's journal from the shipwreck

questGraph.name: Clear Blight in Seagrow Caves
questGraph.description: Help the myconids by clearing the orange crystal blockage and stopping the blight.

objectives.description: Destroy the orange crystal blocking the vent in the Seagrow Caves

questGraph.name: Defeat Harpy and End Shipwrecks
questGraph.description: Defeat the harpy at Compass Rose and end the hazard causing shipwrecks.

objectives.description: Defeat the harpy at Compass Rose shipwreck

questGraph.name: Confront Sparkrender at Observatory
questGraph.description: Confront and stop Sparkrender's ritual at the Clifftop Observatory.

objectives.description: Defeat Sparkrender or disrupt his ritual.

clueNetwork.information: Captain's journal reveals that a cursed talisman animates drowned sailors as zombies.
Orange crystal blocking vent in Seagrow Caves is an egg case from the Elemental Plane of Fire and source of the blight.
Moonstone key activates magical energy bridges at Clifftop Observatory.
Four scholar statues must be rotated to a particular orientation to open secret library at Clifftop Observatory.

immediateActions: Three zombies appear at Dragon's Rest beach

trigger.condition: characters enter LOC_003 > captain's chest discovered

immediateActions: Harpy lands in crow's nest, sings luring song

lines: Your beauty calls to the sea... Come to me, and be lost forever.

trigger.condition: player chooses flee dialogue option in EVENT_002
player chooses fight dialogue option in EVENT_002

immediateActions: Harpy uses Luring Song and attacks players
Sparkrender starts ritual, releases dragon spirits

trigger.condition: sparkrender HP < 10 and attempts to flee

dialogues: Sparkrender: 'You haven't seen the last of me!'

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.effects: Speed 0, disadvantage on attack rolls, attack rolls against have advantage if within 5 feet

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.effects: Speed 0, can't benefit from bonuses to speed

tactics.specialTactics: Use Undead Fortitude to survive most attacks
Use Luring Song to charm players

adjudicationPrinciples: Rule of cool: Allow creative solutions that enhance fun
Fail forward: Failed checks should advance plot in interesting ways
Player agency: Never remove meaningful choice
Consistency: Maintain world logic and established facts

pacingControls.clueInjectionThreshold: If players seem stuck, inject new clue
pacingControls.combatFrequency: Combat occurs whenever the story demands
pacingControls.dramaCurve: Build tension towards climax, provide breathers after intense scenes

improvisationGuidelines.whenPlayersGoOffTrack: Extrapolate from existing world state, create plausible NPCs/locations that fit theme
improvisationGuidelines.unexpectedActions: Determine logical consequences based on rules and narrative
improvisationGuidelines.missingInformation: Make reasonable inferences consistent with established lore

outputSpecification.format: JSON suitable for AI system prompt
validation: All entity references must have corresponding definitions
Event triggers must be logically consistent
Clue network must provide multiple paths to critical information
